analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($86,525) vs SMA5 ($88,337)/SMA20 ($101,733)/SMA50 ($104,614): short- to mid-term trend below moving averages.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($113,580)/SMA200 ($99,809): indicates mid- to long-term trend weakness.
· 52-week position (33.6%) + current price level historically near the low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (24.0 → 30.4): entering oversold exit zone, but still in oversold territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-2416.1323 → -1891.4355): improving but still negative, indicating bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $81,329) + band width of 40.11% suggests expanding volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($85,300): based on 20-day low.
· Swing resistance ($89,580): based on 5-day high, potential for short-term bounce if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: 5-day low > 20-day low * 1.005 not met, 5-day high < 20-day high * 0.995 not met → sideways.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.88x): below 5-day average, indicating reduced conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: within a downtrend, entering oversold territory, but weak bounce potential due to lack of volume. Wait for ADX trend confirmation and accompanying volume before considering buy entry.
